customer_message.subject: Landlord announced termination – nothing in writing yet
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I rent a 4.5-room flat at Bündtenweg 115 in Kreuzlingen from Domicil Plus Immobilien AG.

Last Saturday the owner came by with the property manager and told me in person that his son wants to move into the flat and that they will "end the lease at the end of January". I asked for this in writing, but so far I have received nothing: no letter, no official form.

I want to be prepared. I am not interested in staying longer than necessary if the termination is valid – my new job in Zurich starts in March anyway, so an extension would not help me. But I want to know whether they can terminate for this reason and what my rights are, for example regarding the notice period.

Could you advise me on how to proceed now?

Kind regards,
Luca Achterberg
